title: Heartbreak makes for the best music
gist: Culture essay arguing heartbreak produces musicians' best work, centred on Beck's new album Ride Lonesome (his first studio album in seven years, about his 2021 divorce), alongside Leonard Cohen, Nick Cave, Dolly Parton and Sinéad O'Connor. Little investment-relevant content.

insights.claim: Beck's heartbreak trilogy (Sea Change, Morning Phase, and new album Ride Lonesome) will likely be remembered more fondly than his experimental work like Odelay.
insights.speaker: Alexander Larman
insights.so_what: Minor: catalogue value of confessional albums tends to endure.
